caption: There are four Gabby's Dollhouse Tonies sold in the US: Gabby, Kitty Fairy, Cakey Cat and MerCat, each about $20, with 45 to 50 minutes of stories and songs. None plays without a Toniebox, sold separately: about $99.97 for a Toniebox 2 starter set sold by Walmart.com (it comes with a Ms. Rachel Tonie), about $129.99 for the box on its own at tonies.com. A Short of ours on Nov 22 said two Gabby Tonies; our Nov 26 check finds four. https://everylittleroom.com/guides/gabbys-dollhouse-tonies?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=short&utm_campaign=answer Independent parents' site, not affiliated with the show. Prices are typical US store prices from our dated checks. As an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases.
title: Gabby's Dollhouse Tonies: which four exist, and what you need first
